2087. Using Enumeration Constants for Days of the Week

65

Problem Statement
Use an enum to represent days of the week, read a day number, and print the corresponding enum value back.
Description
Define an enumeration named Day with constants Sunday through Saturday (following the default enum numbering). Read an integer dayNumber, assign it to a variable of type enum Day, and print that variable's integer value.
output_spec: Print the integer value stored in the enum Day variable.
